concept: Signal Box Relaid, finished in its own grammar rather than merged into Branch Lines: the family's week is steel track on green-black slate, straight runs, one 45-degree chamfer at each turn, a terminus ring where a line begins and a T buffer where it ends, and #6dff9c lit only where attention belongs. Every count stands at its line's buffer, the one lamp legend is Status's tally and now draws five signals in five shapes, the form is a line whose lit stop sits on the focused field's own centre line, and the plans carry one cool period colour. It should feel like a calm, exact signal box at night: its question, its box and its live lamps lit, everything else matte steel and slate.
companions: Steel #a7c4d8 is the one main companion, with a job: here (the latched cell with its steel run, and today's cell on the month under a 3px steel cap), the hollow to-come and waiting rings, links and the ends of lines; its darker kin draw the diagram (rail #607385, wire #4f5e6b, buffer #8a9aa8, pewter #6f7b85, and #2b333a, the unlit lens that means off). The plans' cyan #70dcf4 is a measured period colour: a 2px cap at 70% on every plan plate (Home's fortnight, the Plans list) and the to-come rings on plans, so Home is not grey and green alone. Sage #86d9a6 means done, and is the lit edge of a row's afterglow and the halo a row's stop takes when it is pointed at. Amber means late or needs a look and nothing else ('2 late', the late stamps and lamps, the setup board's edge, and now the page still on the installer's password). Kinds keep their colour in the ring alone (terracotta, moss, wheat, lilac, cyan, pink), and a ring brightens to its full kind colour when its row is pointed at. Bone #ebe6da carries the heads and figures.
title: What shall we *plan*? Kept from the first draft of this design and tested this round, as the tour's lessons name it the track series' TRY NEXT. It is the box's own label on Home, 40px Archivo 700 condensed (28px on the phone, one line), bone with 'plan' in the lit word's two-layer halo, the largest and brightest head on Home. It keeps Relaid's household 'we' and display size and puts the light on the job: a weekend, a trip, an idea to keep, a reminder, the calendar are all things the family plans together by telling Vera. If a lens calls 'shall' stiff, the judges' fallback is 'What's the plan?' in the same setting.
decisions: Title kept: 'What shall we plan?' in Relaid's 40px condensed setting with the light on the job word, as the lessons' TRY NEXT for the track series asks to test.

Status tells the same story as Settings and Home. The page still on the installer's (or a shared) password is no longer a lit green lamp: its row takes the amber 'needs a look' lamp, so the tally reads 'live 5 · waiting 1 · off 2 · not set up 4 · needs a look 1', which agrees with Settings' 'Sign-in and security: Needs a look' and Home's first setup step. This copy maps the row in status.html's state_of; the real change is status.py setting that row's `on` to None while the shared password is in force.

Five signals in five shapes, one legend for every page: live is the lit phosphor lamp; waiting (and to come) the hollow steel ring; off an unlit lens, a #2b333a disc in a 1.5px pewter rim; not set up a hollow pewter ring crossed by the lineage's own 45-degree bar (the chamfer, in pewter), replacing the dashed ring that read as a spinner at 12px; needs a look filled amber. Settings' lamps, To do's cancelled stop and Who answers' fallback follow the same shapes.

Plans' month is no longer an even grid. Three tones: the days from today on sit on the plate (#161c20, the lighter band), past days a step darker than the board (#0b1013), today the latched cell with its steel cap and lamp; next month's days only dim their numeral. The four past weeks fold to 44px rows, so the week ahead is most of what the eye meets. The plan chips are lifted a step (#1c242a) so they still read on the lighter band.

Bent from the note: the figure at the buffer now stands only on the list ('5 coming'); on the month the shelf ends at its buffer with no figure, because routes.plans_month is given only the five weeks it draws and this copy will not guess the page's count (shipping would pass it, so both views say '5 coming'). The grid's own count stands on the month's head row beside 'September 2026' as '2 still to come in these weeks', and is hidden on the phone, whose month list shows only the month's own days.

The form as a line, reworked: Kind and Suggested by (or Status, when editing) share one row again (24rem + 24rem + the rest), so New idea is back to its parent's height, with one stop for the row that lights when either field has focus. Every stop moved from the label's line to the field's own centre line, as Sign in does, and the gutter narrowed to 2.5rem with the rail 12px from the fields, so the lit stop and the lit field read as one (and the details strip's typing crop now shows most of the lit lamp beside the lit field). On the phone the row goes back to one column and each field keeps its own stop.

Home on the phone: the Next up tube is a short strip under the box, about 170 CSS px (from about 250), with a 4.5rem scope in its corner and 'Silver Falls hike' on one line at 1.25rem; the question, the box and Send stay the first screen's brightest group.

The table standard held everywhere: Ideas' column heads take the rows' own inline padding, so Kind, Drive, Way and For stand over their values; Status's cost tables set every head in 13px DM Sans 500 in label steel, sentence case ('What for', 'Calls', 'US$'), numeric heads right-aligned over tabular figures (one rule for every .data table, by ::first-letter, so no words change); the fortnight's 'OCT / SUN' is now 'Oct / Sun', untracked, the last tracked caps gone.

The radar's readings on Ideas are set as readouts: 'Nearest 18 min NW', then '#7 Pumpkin patch at Bi-Mart farm' on a line of its own; 'Furthest 2 h 45 min W', then '#4 Cannon Beach weekend'. No reading breaks inside a name any more, and the way is in lower case without the brackets the tube's day tags keep.

A typesetting rule written down: mono is for figures in fixed places (times, dates, ids, the machine's stamps); a relative day ('in 4 days', 'tomorrow') is words and takes the text face, so the plates read '13:00 in 4 days' with the clock in DM Mono and the words in DM Sans.

The row afterglow has its second place, in the lineage's terms: pointing at a row lights its stop on the line in sage with a 6px halo (To do's timetable on Home and its page, the fortnight's stops, the setup steps), and pointing at an idea's row brightens its kind ring to full colour with a soft halo; both on in .12s and off over 1.2s, beside the 2px sage edge and 6% steel wash. The kind ring shows in the afterglow frames at 0 and 120ms.

The setup page's current step is drawn as Home's next step is: a hollow ring with a phosphor rim, a tight halo and a lit numeral, not a filled lamp that sits beside the sage 'done' discs. One rule now marks where you act (your turn, Next step, the setup page's step) and another marks now (the filled lamp).

Kept from the first draft: the figure at the buffer on Ideas ('12 ideas') and To do ('4 open · 2 late', '2 late' in amber linking to the first late row); the tally under the lede beside the spend tube; boards as tall as their content; Home's greeting sight line (the tube's spill at 25%, the box glowing at rest, Send's ring and pool); 'Wednesday 30 September' in Archivo 500 at 15px; setup as a vertical station line; the fortnight's plates hung from their stops with cyan caps and the rail ending 16px after the last stop; 16px row titles; chat's one timetable margin; 'Save a thought for later' in the head; the capped, sticky radar; the 'Edit' key in words; the kids' wishes on one 44px line.

Budget: 59.8K of 60K. Paid for by deleting the greeting's second radial layer (its top highlight is now a 1px line), the unused desktop now-run rule and the phone's highlight height, and by the squeezer writing the companions' tints as hex with alpha, dropping the spaces around '/', and shortening the sheet's nine longest custom property names in the built copy only; the readable source is src/relaid.css, built by src/build.py.
strengths: Every fix the studio critic ranked is in, in the lineage's own grammar: Status agrees with Settings and Home, five lamps have five shapes, the month has a lighter week ahead and folded past weeks, the form is back to its parent's height with the lit stop on the lit field, Home's phone tube is a strip, the tables have one standard, and the last tracked caps are gone.

The line language is a system with a job on every page: terminus, rail, chamfer, stop, buffer, the figure at the buffer (Ideas, To do, Plans list), the legend as a counted tally (Status, and the same lamps on Settings), the form as a line, the setup steps as a station line, and now the row's stop as the afterglow's second place.

Light is a short list and each item earns it: 'plan', the mark, Send, the box glowing at rest on Home and Chat, the now lamp and its lit stretch, where you act (your turn, Next step, the setup step), a focused field's stop, the live lamps and the tubes at full strength; everything else is matte slate and steel.

Typesetting with rules that would hold on any page: a written scale (13 labels, 15 small, 16 reading, 24 heads and figures, 40 titles), sentence case everywhere, mono only for figures in fixed places, tabular figures under right-aligned heads, headings balanced, no name broken on the glass.

Usable at a glance and by hand: 0 targets under 44px on all thirteen shots, nothing under 13px, no sideways scroll at 1280 or 390, counts said once, late said in amber words that link to the late row, and the phosphor focus ring.
weaknesses: Home is still recognisably its parent's layout (greeting and tube, setup, the fortnight, To do beside Lately added); this round's changes are mostly on Status, Plans, the form and the phone, so at thumbnail size Home reads as the first draft's.

The page's figure is missing from the month view's buffer: the month route is not given the plans past its five weeks, so the list says '5 coming' at the buffer and the month says '2 still to come in these weeks' on its own head row instead. Shipping it needs one value passed from routes.plans_month.

Several states are still worked out in the templates from words: Status's needs-a-look, not set up, waiting and off (from each row's detail), Settings' lamps, To do's late and count, the month's count. The real changes belong in status.py, settings.overview and views.task_row.

The fortnight's plates hang to the left of their stops, so the date and the stop come after the plan's name in reading order; it reads as arrivals on a line, but a judge used to a timeline may find it backwards.
On the Edit form the rail runs about 700px past the open 'Everything else' fold with no stop, since the fold's fields hang from its one stop; it reads as a long empty stretch of track.
The palette is still slate, steel and green, with cyan, amber and sage in small jobs; variety comes from caps, lamps and rings rather than surfaces (Status is 57% green of its colour, Chat 84%).
Words differ from today's by up to 10.7% on Home (the title, the date's case, 'Next step', '2 late', the kids' line) and on To do ('Edit' in words, the Show form as keys, '4 shown' gone).
The stylesheet is at 59.8K of 60K and its built copy uses shortened names for nine custom properties; the next graft will need deletions of its own.
